about: First-time win-rate bands for levels 1 to 5, per pillar and per bot, from the Advisor's targets. Hero stats are not nerfed to meet them. A figure that misses its band can only be listed in known_misses with its measured value: CI then fails if it gets worse or comes back inside its band.
measure: HoldfastCurve.climb: a first-time player who buys the cheapest star and gold nodes between runs, wears the gear found, places posts and replays a level until it wins. A rate is first-attempt wins over the players who reached the level. Bots: average (reacts in 6 ticks, special every decision), poor (18 ticks, special every second decision).
pillar_levels_note: Which levels each pillar is judged on (a pillar not named is judged on all five). The Dusk Mage unlocks at the level 5 boss and the Tideblade at the next biome boss, so both are tuned to the biomes they unlock into (Advisor view 2026-10-30, Head of Engineering decision). Gull Rock, the hardest level that exists, stands in for them. WIDEN THE SCOPE when a later biome exists. The gate fails if a pillar's scope is empty. Levels outside a scope are reported as not played by that pillar yet.

fork_gap.how: per level and pillar, the first-time win rate of the Volley side against the Sniper side (average bot, 12 players each)

special_gap.how: per pillar, the first-time win rate of the average bot with its special less the same players with it never pressed; the mean over the levels judged is at most 40 points (the special is worth pressing, not required), and the first level is winnable without it

one_post.how: the Dusk Mage with only the first castle slot bought, average bot, 12 players

known_misses_note: A pinned miss may not get worse, and CI fails if it comes back inside its band (delete the pin then). Build 12a (HF-M2-28) removed every pin that levels and data could fix and pinned what remains, each with its cause. flare_archer/special_gap/mean: the Flare special is about three times the arrow and a win rate falls from near 100% to near 0% within about 10% of enemy strength, so the gap is close to the win rate on any level that is not trivial; fixed by the arrow and special rebalance (HF-M2-63), which also brings the per-level +15 to +35 target. Dusk Mage: Levels 1 to 5 are shared by all three pillars, so Gull Rock cannot be made hard enough for the Dusk Mage without taking the Flare Archer out of band, and monsters must not depend on the Hero picked; Hero stats are not changed to meet bands. The Dusk Mage and the Tideblade special gap are tuned when the biome they unlock into exists.

fork_feel.first_level_note: Judged from this level on: at Outpost no fork node is affordable yet (the first costs 600 gold), so the two sides cannot differ there. A player who picks a side saves up for its chain.
fork_feel.how: per level and pillar, the larger of the gap in Keep health left (a share of full health) and in clear time (a share of the longer one) between the Volley side and the Sniper side, first attempts of the average bot: the two sides must feel different even where they win as often
